name: devkit
description: Multi-agent development pipeline for Claude Code. /dev-spec builds a grounded task spec; /dev-plan triages (defaulting to the cheap tiers) and turns a task into a validated step plan, or explains existing code into reusable findings; /dev-implement runs the steps in dependency waves with contract gates and cost-driven review checkpoints; /dev-review loops reviewers until clean and can apply a persisted PR review's findings; /dev-debug reproduces, refutes hypotheses and proves the repro dead; /dev-pr drafts and gates publication; /dev-status and /dev-setup manage flows and repo configuration. Context is push-only and every file has one writer; verification means running a check, not reading code.
